text:
Maria (infra): Heads-up — Orchid customer is targeting Dedicated + VPC go-live. Need a 60m deployment review to run through network, model pin, canary plan, and rollback. Who's available next week? :calendar:
Kevin (solutions): Thu 10:00–11:00 PT works for me. Jordan — can you check the customer's preferred window?
Jordan (AM): Client said afternoons CET; Thu 18:00 CET = Thu 10:00 PT should work. Pinged them to confirm.
Anita (security): Add me for the network/certs section. I want to validate KMS key access and EKS/VM firewall rules.
DevOps Oncall: I can join for the canary/runbook parts. Prefer Fri morning PT if we need extra prep time.
deploy-bot: Deployment readiness checklist created: https://redwood.app/runbooks/orchid-deploy-checklist (auto) :white_check_mark:
Maria (infra): Agenda draft: 1) Quick status (5m) 2) Network & peering (15m) 3) Auth/KMS & secrets (10m) 4) Model config + pinning (10m) 5) Canary plan + load tests (10m) 6) Rollback & SLAs (5m) 7) Action items (5m). Thoughts?
Kevin (solutions): Add "service account / ip allowlist" under network. Also need to confirm whether they want cross-region failover — if yes, we should cover routing policy.
Anita (security): Please add cert rotation cadence and audit log export destination. Also request: send pre-meeting access matrix (who has which role) so I can spot gaps.
Maria (infra): Good call. Jordan — can you collect the access matrix and attach before the call? Prefer 24h notice.
Jordan (AM): On it. Will upload CSV to the meeting thread by Tue 16:00 CET.
DevOps Oncall: For canary, recommend two-stage: 5% traffic 30m, then 25% 1h, then full. Need customer approval for traffic slicing. Also want to run the healthcheck command during meeting:
```
# inside customer's VPC, test egress to redis and model endpoint
curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 https://orchid-test.health/redwood-ping || echo "NET_ERR"
```
Kevin (solutions): We'll also bring the ingress/firewall rule snippet they should apply (example below):
```
# ALLOW egress to Redwood endpoints
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 34.56.78.90 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
```
Maria (infra): Two scheduling options now that Jordan confirmed CET: Thu 10:00 PT / Thu 18:00 CET (preferred) or Fri 08:00 PT / Fri 16:00 CET. Which is better?
Kevin (solutions): Thu still best for me. Anita?
Anita (security): Thu ok. DevOps Oncall?
DevOps Oncall: I can move things, Thu 10 PT fine.
Maria (infra): OK locking Thu 1769808600 (that's Thu 10:00 PT). I'll send calendar invite with runbook and pre-reqs. Please review the runbook beforehand: https://redwood.app/runbooks/orchid-deploy-checklist
Jordan (AM): Client confirmed Thu. Also asked for a short ops playbook PDF — I'll attach in the invite.
Anita (security): Quick ask — can someone verify that their VPC has egress to our metrics endpoint (metrics.redwood:443)? If not, we need a ticket for network ops.
Maria (infra): I'll run a quick probe and post results in this thread before EOD. If it fails, we escalate.
Kevin (solutions): Final note — bring the rollback image tag and the expected data retention windows for logs.
Maria (infra): Great. If anything else arises, drop it here. Thanks team :thumbsup:
